data.name: Nazirah
data.gender_notes: Nazirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A watchful and vigilant person who keeps an eye on the affairs of others. The name Nazirah carries the meaning “Watchful, Vigilant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazirah usually hope their child will grow to embody watchful, vigilant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is entrusted with the responsibility of watching over the faith and the community.
data.etymology: Nazirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Watchful, Vigilant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazirah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nazirah is an Arabic name and in the Islamic culture, it is given to a girl who is believed to be an observant and watchful individual. Nazirah is a name that evokes a sense of responsibility and attentiveness towards the world around her. In the Islamic tradition, watching over and guarding sacred spaces is a form of worship and is highly valued. A person named Nazirah is expected to carry these qualities into her everyday life and uphold the moral values and teachings of Islam. The name is also associated with dedication and commitment, symbolizing a person who is focused and reliable in her actions and intentions.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Nazirah is a reminder of the importance of consciousness and mindfulness in our daily lives. It is a reminding of the Islamic concept of stewardship, where we are entrusted with the care and custody of the world around us. The name Nazirah implies a deep sense of intuition and an inner ability to perceive the truth and beauty in all things. It invites us to be attentive and responsive to the signs of the universe and to align ourselves with the divine will. In this way, the name Nazirah can serve as a powerful reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and the importance of staying present and focused on our spiritual journey.
